newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer repeats no Cristinas decree issued.
newsitem.headline: Placer repeats no Cristinas decree issued.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc, battling with Crystallex International Corp over the Las Cristinas gold property in Venezuela, repeated on Wednesday that no ruling giving Crystallex title to the property had been officially gazetted.

Crystallex earlier said its claim to two blocks of the property were confirmed with the gazetting on May 15 of three Supreme Court rulings and a registered assignment agreement in Venezuela. The company said it received a copy of the Official Gazette earlier this week.
"We're not aware of that," Placer Dome spokesman Hugh Leggatt said. "But the bottom line is, it doesn't make any difference."

Placer has flatly rejected Crystallex's argument that it should rightfully have control of the concessions. Venezuelan government officials and CVG, the Venezuelan state-owned company that is a 30 percent partner in Las Cristinas, have sided with Placer.
The dispute has delayed the start of construction on a US$576 million mine at the site.
